newsitem.title: USA: Commercial Assets sets special div, Q3 div.
newsitem.headline: Commercial Assets sets special div, Q3 div.

text.p: Commercial Assets Inc said Thursday it has set a special dividend of $0.04 a share and a regular third-quarter dividend of $0.17 a share payable to shareholders of record on September 30.
The dividends are to be paid out on October 10.
The company said the special dividend is being offered as a result of a one-time gain of $1.745 million from a previously announced bond redemption in May 1996 and other mortgage prepayments.
Commercial Assets is a real estate investment trust based in Denver, Colo.
